Name: Customizable Trinkets - Better Fairy Box Trinket
Author: plantsandprose
Description:
[font=Tahoma][b]Overview[/b]

I'm personally obsessed with the new trinkets in the game and could not be more happy to have a fairy companion following me around all day, but I really wanted to be able to pick what my fairy looked like...so I made this mod.

[b]About[/b]

The current variants are:

chappell: inspired by Chappell Roan's Coachella 2024 weekend 2 butterfly outfit
firebird: inspired by Misty Copeland's Firebird
folklorico: inspired by the cultural dance of Baile folkorico
godmother: inspired by Whitney Houston as the Fairy Godmother in Cinderella (1997)
goth: just a cute little goth fairy
iridessa: inspired by Iridessa from Tinkerbell
vidia: inspired by Vidia from Tinkerbell

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tYCfC3m/fairy-lineup-v2.png[/img]

*More variants are in the works so check back once updates are released to see our new options :)
**If you would like to suggest new fairy options, I encourage you to make a comment in the Post section. I will check these for suggestions and try to make them happen.

[b]Installation[/b]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma]Download and extract the mod file.[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Copy the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Open the game. This will prompt SMAPI to generate a config file in the Challenging Community Center Bundles mod folder.[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Close out Stardew Valley after SMAPI has fully run and the Start Menu loads.[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]The default fairy is set to the goth variant. If you would like to use a different variant, open the config file using Notepad or Microsoft Visual Studio. This file can be found in the [CP] Better Fairy Trinket folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods directory. [/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Change the variant from goth to the variant of your choosing.[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Save the file. Once your reopen your game, you will now have the Fairy Trinket of your choice.[/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma]
[b]Special Thanks[/b][/font]
Special thanks to amateurarchaeologist for their encouragement in making this mod as well as helping to create all of the wonderful graphics for nexus.
